key_insight: Split complex-valued PINNs improve representation of oscillatory and phase-dependent PDE solutions by learning real and imaginary components separately, reducing spectral bias versus standard real-valued PINNs.
engineering_relevance: This offers a more accurate and flexible surrogate for forward and inverse fluid/physics problems, especially where waves, nonlinear dynamics, or parameter identification are critical.
method: Complex-valued network parameters and latent states
Split activations apply standard real activations separately to real and imaginary parts
Evaluated on forward and inverse PDEs with ablation over activations and collocation sampling
evidence_signal: The abstract reports lower relative L2 errors and better parameter recovery across many benchmarks, including a 3D Navier-Stokes Beltrami case with relative L2 error of 4.07 × 10^-5.
watch_item: Complex-valued training and split-activation design may add implementation complexity, and performance can still depend on collocation strategy and benchmark-specific tuning.
paper_title: Split Complex-Valued Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Forward and Inverse Nonlinear PDEs
